scope: Read-only attachment audit against V3 original-package retargets. No animation, skeleton, mesh or gameplay asset edited.

preview_recommendation.use_for: Uniform A/B/C/D comparison capture; binding preview only

evidence: Source-to-native RightHand quaternion mapping is constant over all six clips, maximum measured drift below 0.00032 degrees.

The original heavy clips' RightHand-minus-LeftHand axis is approximately source hand -Y during the two-handed strike. This is grip-axis inference, not an authored package socket; source mannequin has no sockets.
The proposed attachment reproduces source hand -Y as weapon tip axis and source hand +X as cutting edge; existing attachment instead points near source +Z.

Observed GripKeyframes/A_002, A_003 and D_003: blade no longer points down through the back during the same pre-swing pose; blade extends visibly in front at the heavy finish and above shoulder for D.

Weapon pivot already lies at the leather grip center: ArtSource/Weapons/Yueyao/prepare_yueyao_weapon.py line52. Slender revision preserves the original grip pivot. No -9cm pivot compensation is warranted.
limits: Source grip-axis sign assumes the right hand is the forward hand during the two-handed attack; confirmed visually for these preview keyframes but no original weapon mesh/socket exists to prove author intent.

Source light03 has a different cut plane and mixed up/down movement. Cutting-edge velocity statistics alone are insufficient to reverse the blade only for that clip; keep one binding for fair comparison and inspect its eventual attack window if selected.
No human gameplay or headset validation is claimed.
